summary: quick-dev-tdd-adapter applies only to an explicit execution-plans directory/file with schema-valid implementation-contract.v1.json; standalone/compact/missing/invalid contracts reject. Parent router must run first with caller quick-dev-tdd-adapter and return lane strict_tdd_plan plus matching backend. Read only target plan directory; resolve one 95-*.md report, fail closed on duplicates/escaping/ambiguity; reports/run-state are non-authoritative. Run loop_plan_directory before expensive actions; use lifecycle tools and shell-free structured commands. Require skill-input contract preparation, typed semantic child, and ready validation before action/prepare/RED. Derive hash-bound model class (architectural, complex, normal, small_mechanical); unknown/contradictory facts block as complex; decision is non-authorizing. Verify frozen knowledge context and hashes; mismatches route to VDD repair. Execute RED with expected nonzero before production write, then GREEN, REFACTOR, slice predicate; never import/prebind RED into new VDD plans. Continue slices automatically until plan terminal predicate, external repair, or repeated failure. Adapter terminal result only implementation-complete; acceptance/commit/release remain external. P0/P1 repair completion requires repair-review handoff and Acceptance audit with preserved manifests, hashes, consumers, tests, validation, root-cause inventory, and composition receipts. Persistent loop consumes explicit execution_snapshot_paths; planned_new_files are exact and staged by RED/GREEN/REFACTOR. Version-sensitive diffs require exact-version Context7 documentation before commit; repository-owned-only diffs make gate not applicable. Never use backend text, capsules, run state, clean exit, handoff, or skill as acceptance authority.
